name: Bootle Leisure Centre
imageAlt: The red-brick and blue-glass frontage of Bootle Leisure Centre across a grass lawn
summary: A 25m pool with a moveable floor, a leisure pool with flume, sauna and steam rooms, plus a fitness suite and busy class studio in North Park.
description: The Active Fitness suite at Bootle Leisure Centre hosts classes ranging from low-intensity yoga to high-intensity Bootcamp and Boxercise. Whatever your level of fitness, there will be a session that is right for you — in the water or out of it.
hoursNote: Last fitness suite admission 8:30pm weekdays, 3:30pm weekends. The pool closes at 3:30pm at weekends.
timetableNote: From the centre’s published timetables: classes from 7 September 2026; pool timetable for 5–25 October 2026. Swimming lessons and club sessions aren’t listed. Weekend afternoon swims can change for private party bookings.

name: Crosby Lakeside Adventure Centre
imageAlt: Crosby Lakeside Adventure Centre beside the marine lake
summary: A refurbished gym and two activity studios on the edge of the marine lake, with paddlesports, sailing and a café overlooking the water.
description: Crosby Lakeside features a recently refurbished Active Fitness suite with up-to-date machines and free weights, plus two activity studios for an extensive range of classes. Step outside and the lake is yours: stand-up paddleboarding, kayaking and sailing run through the year.
address: The Esplanade, off Cambridge Road, Waterloo L22 1RR
hoursNote: Lake sessions depend on weather and water conditions.
timetableNote: From the centre’s published class timetable, from 16 January 2026. Lake activities are booked separately and aren’t listed here.

name: Dunes Splash World
imageAlt: Twisting water flumes above the Splash World sign at Dunes, Southport
summary: Southport’s seafront water park and leisure centre: flumes and wave pool, a 25m pool, learner pool, spin studio and a fitness suite that overlooks the slides.
description: Dunes is a combined leisure centre and water-based theme park on Southport’s Esplanade. The leisure side offers a 12m learner pool and a 25m main pool, while upstairs a large sprung-floor studio and a new spin studio run around 90 classes a week. The ground floor has a four-court sports hall, with four new 3G pitches outside.
amenities: Splash World leisure pool and flumes
timetableNote: From the centre’s published timetables: classes from 23 February 2026; pool timetable current from 1 September 2026. £2 swims are for over-60s and under-16s (term time only).

name: Litherland Sports Park
imageAlt: The exterior of Litherland Sports Park
summary: A floodlit six-lane athletics track, 1km cycle circuit and 3G pitches, with a 40-station gym and activity studio indoors.
description: One of the finest sports facilities in the region. The floodlit six-lane, all-weather track has full field athletics facilities and a centre pitch, alongside a 1km cycle circuit, floodlit 3G football pitches and grass pitches for adults and juniors. Indoors, the fitness suite has 40 stations and the activity studio runs a full class programme.
hoursNote: Pitch hire is available outside class times — call the centre to book.
timetableNote: From the centre’s published class timetable dated 19 September 2025 — the latest on the venue page. Track and pitch hire aren’t listed; call the centre to book.

name: Meadows Leisure Centre
imageAlt: The exterior of Meadows Leisure Centre in Maghull
summary: A five-lane 25m pool and learner pool, a sauna and steam health suite, a 65-station gym and nearly 100 classes a week across three studios.
description: Set over two floors, Meadows has a 25m five-lane pool and a 12.5m learner pool with a changing village, family cubicles and an accessible changing room. The health suite sits poolside. Upstairs, the 65-station fitness suite is joined by a spin studio, a functional training area and two sprung-floor studios.
hoursNote: Accessible changing room and family cubicles available poolside.
timetableNote: From the centre’s published timetables: classes from 26 January 2026, pool from 2 March 2026. Virtual classes are screen-led Les Mills sessions. Swimming lessons and club bookings aren’t listed. Availability is shown when you book.

name: Netherton Activity Centre
imageAlt: The exterior of Netherton Activity Centre
summary: A community hub with a fitness suite, badminton courts, a floodlit 3G pitch for 5- and 7-a-side, a free crèche for members and Jake’s Sensory World.
description: The NAC has a well-equipped fitness suite — treadmills, cross trainers, cycles, rowers and a Smith machine — with a stretching area, free weights and a Power Plate station. From toddlers to teens to parents, there is something for every age, whether that is a dance session, a kickabout on the 3G or an hour to yourself while the crèche looks after the little ones.
hoursNote: The crèche is free with membership; places are limited.
timetableNote: From the centre’s published class timetable, from 3 August 2026. There are no classes at weekends. Pitch and court hire aren’t listed; call the centre to book.
